about.heading: About EFH
about.subtitle: Clarify: i have absolute no willing to write this blyat about page so the content below is fully uncensored ai generated and i dont wanna care.
about.intro: EFH (Escape From HDSB Project) is a network acceleration and internet-freedom project slowly built in spare time by a group of students chased by homework and firewalls alike. We believe the internet should have no borders.
about.mission: We run four nodes across different regions to provide stable, low-latency proxy access, alongside small tools such as one-click config import, service status and a standalone blocking-check app — so everyone can climb over the wall named HDSB.
about.stack: The server is Kotlin + Ktor; nodes run trojan-go with nginx, and certificates renew automatically via acme.sh. The frontend is plain HTML / CSS / JavaScript, proudly zero-dependency and fast to load.
about.disclaimer: This project is for learning and researching network technology only. Please follow the laws of your region. Any consequence of using this service is borne by the user.
